deadline.value: Applications submitted by January 15, 2027 get full consideration; later ones are reviewed through April or until positions fill.
deadline.quote: For Fall 2027 admissions, applications submitted by January 15, 2027 will be given full consideration

also.quote: After this date, the graduate committee will review new applications through April or until all positions are filled

gre_general.value: GRE is not required this year, but the department strongly encourages submitting scores.
gre_general.quote: GRE scores are not required this year. However, we strongly encourage applicants to submit GRE scores

fee_waiver.value: The department grants a limited number of application fee waivers, decided after the January 15 deadline.
fee_waiver.quote: A limited number of waivers to the application fee are available.

toefl_min.value: The department asks for TOEFL iBT 79.

ielts_min.value: The department asks for IELTS Academic 6, lower than the Graduate College's 6.5.

supervisor.value: Students are admitted to the program overall; no faculty sponsor is needed first.
supervisor.quote: No. Students are admitted to the program overall. There is no need to specify a potential advisor.

funding.value: All successful PhD applicants are offered a teaching assistantship.
funding.quote: For the MA/PhD program, all successful applicants will be offered a teaching assistantship

entry_route.value: Applicants without a master's enter through the MA/PhD route; applicants with a master's enter the PhD program.
entry_route.quote: the MA program if you're interested in a PhD in mathematics and do not have a masters degree in mathematics, or the PhD program if you're interested in a PhD in mathematics and have a masters degree in mathematics

gre_subject.value: The page does not mention a subject GRE for this field.

notes: Department states its own IELTS and TOEFL minimums, which differ from the Graduate College table.
